# gemini-plugin-cc

> Unofficial Claude Code plugin that lets Claude Code use Google Gemini through the Antigravity CLI (`agy`): read-only code reviews (`/gemini:review`), adversarial design reviews (`/gemini:adversarial-review`), and task delegation (`/gemini:rescue`), with background jobs and an optional stop-time review gate. Fork of OpenAI's codex-plugin-cc (Apache-2.0).

Key facts:

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add azixxxxx/gemini-plugin-cc`, then `/plugin install gemini@gemini-cc`, `/reload-plugins`, and `/gemini:setup`.
- Requires the Antigravity CLI `agy`, bundled with Google's Gemini desktop app or installed from https://antigravity.google/download, signed in once with `agy` and `/login`, plus Node.js 18.18 or later.
- Works with personal Google accounts. Gemini CLI stopped accepting them in June 2026, which is why the plugin uses agy.
- A per-run tool guard (an agy PreToolUse hook) keeps reviews read-only and blocks `git commit`, `git push`, and edits outside the repository in write-capable runs.
- Not affiliated with Google, Anthropic, or OpenAI.
